description: Pinned external posse case t1222 head bd2af87f.
intent:
feat(review): run Greenhouse in parallel with built-in review per Project and compare Verdicts (Phase 1 G-3)

Done when: A Project config key `review_parallel = "greenhouse"` (unset by default) makes Posse request a Greenhouse Verdict through the G-2 adapter for each head the built-in loop reviews, and record it in the G-1 Verdict table with `mode = parallel`, as specified in docs/research/2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md sections 2.6 and 2.8 (step G-3).; A Project with the key set and no built-in review (`defaults.review = none`) still gets a parallel Verdict for each PR head it gates. Those rows count toward reliability, inconclusive share, wrong-head and latency, and never toward recall.; Parallel Verdicts and their findings are stored only. They never reach the author, never block or allow Publish or Merge, and a Greenhouse failure or refusal never delays the built-in loop. A failure raises at most one Notice per head.; `posse stats` gains a review comparison that computes every G1 threshold in section 2.6 from stored rows, per Project and in total, with the number of reviewed heads.; The key is frozen in each admitted Task's plan. Unsetting it stops new parallel requests and changes nothing else.; No change to existing review, publish or merge behaviour when the key is unset.

expected.defect: The parallel review is detached and its exit status is discarded. If the child exits before greenhouseReview reaches its request-ledger failure handling—such as failing in openDB, project/task lookup, lead validation, or another early command error—the parent records neither a failed request nor the required failure Notice, so the shadow run silently loses a Greenhouse failure.
